callees.name: _SourceIndex.build
callees.pre_condition: source is a non-empty string containing source code text.
callees.post_condition: Returns a _SourceIndex instance that indexes the source text by line boundaries, enabling position-to-offset and range-to-source queries for the given source.

callees.name: _SourceIndex.source_for_range
callees.pre_condition: self is a _SourceIndex instance built from the same source string handed to _source_for_range. lsp_range is a dict with 'start' and 'end' entries, each being a dict with 'line' and 'character' entries, where start does not follow end in the indexed source.
callees.post_condition: Returns the substring of the indexed source from the byte offset of lsp_range['start'] (inclusive) to the byte offset of lsp_range['end'] (exclusive).
